name: Axolotl Regenerative Suite
description: The most complex and expensive defensive geneware available outside military programs. Introduces axolotl-derived regenerative genes that allow the body to regrow damaged tissue — including muscle, nerve, bone, and organ tissue — at dramatically accelerated rates. A broken bone heals in days instead of weeks. A deep laceration closes in hours. Given enough time and metabolic resources, the system can regrow severed fingers and toes, though full limb regeneration remains beyond current civilian-grade installations. The regeneration is not instantaneous — it requires enormous caloric intake during healing, and the user must eat constantly while recovering from serious injury. Helix Biosystems' top-tier installation approaches limited organ regeneration — a damaged liver or kidney can be restored over weeks. The technology represents the cutting edge of geneware engineering and carries a price tag to match.
source_organism: Ambystoma mexicanum (axolotl), Hydra vulgaris (freshwater hydra, cellular immortality genes)
tier_availability: Tier 5 (limited Tier 4 availability for reduced versions)
procedure: Systemic retroviral rewrite with stem cell seeding, 12 sessions over 6 months
reversibility: Irreversible — the regenerative changes are integrated at the stem cell level
side_effects: Extreme caloric demand during healing (10,000+ calories/day for serious injuries)
Risk of uncontrolled cell growth (tumors) if regenerative signals misfire
Scarring patterns differ from normal — healed tissue is visibly smoother and paler
Psychological dependency — users take greater physical risks knowing they can heal
Rare: regeneration of removed tissue (wisdom teeth regrow, appendix returns)
social_perception: Envied and resented. Regenerative capability is the clearest marker of wealth in GLMZ — if you can heal from anything, you can afford to live dangerously. Tier 1 residents view regen users with a mixture of awe and bitter resentment.
story_hooks: A regenerative user is found dead — their healing factor should have saved them from the injuries that killed them, meaning someone used a weapon specifically designed to overwhelm regeneration
A black-market regen installation produces uncontrolled growth — the user's body is regenerating tissue that was never damaged, growing new structures that have no place in human anatomy
